# `nlink-lab verify`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Check a running lab for drift against its topology (exit 2 on drift).

Compares every node's live links/addresses/routes, nftables and WireGuard peers with what the topology declares — the same view `apply --dry-run` shows — and prints the differences. Meant for CI and monitoring: exit 0 means the lab is exactly what its file says.

Usage: nlink-lab verify [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

      --file <FILE>
          Compare the live lab against this topology file (`.nll` or `.nlz`) instead of the topology it runs: a CI gate on what `apply FILE` would change

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          Set a `param` value for --file (repeatable): --set key=value

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
